title: SEMINAR ON HOSPITALITY INDUSTRY
duration: 45 hours (30 hours lecture and 15 hours discussion/practical)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be updated on current issues related to hospitality management.
Students will develop the ability to identify, analyze, discuss, and critique business problems and trends in the hospitality industry.
Students will demonstrate active learning and self-discipline, showing responsibility, integrity, and respect for cultural traditions.
Students will acquire skills necessary for service operations within hotels.
Students will develop critical thinking skills to analyze and critique business problems and trends in the hospitality industry.
Students will work collaboratively in groups, demonstrating effective teamwork and communication skills.
